preconditions.description: The integer u must be between 0 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.description: If no valid array exists, output '-1'.

postconditions.description: If both u and v are 0, output '0' indicating an empty array.
postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if u == 0 and v == 0 else True

postconditions.description: If a valid array exists, output its length and elements.
postconditions.expression: any(x for x in range(1, 10**18 + 1) if (x ^ u == u) and (x + v == v))
